content.title: Universal Technical Institute’s (NYSE:UTI) Q3 CY2025: Beats On Revenue
content.summary: Vocational education Universal Technical Institute (NYSE:UTI) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 13.3% year on year to $222.4 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $910 million at the midpoint came in 0.9% above analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $0.34 per share was 32.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
